name: argument-parser-negative-test-706c373f17/too-many-args-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

## Invocations / ### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The function and required int parameter are supported, but the assertion requires the external command-line argument parser to reject two arguments for main(int i) with a panic. The subset does not cover command-line main argument binding or excess-argument rejection; function signature and invocation support do not establish this execution protocol.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line main argument binding and panic on excess command-line arguments
test_design_notes: @args supplies two strings while main declares one required parameter; @panic asserts rejection before the empty body executes.
